identification: Wykeham Perry (1936-2021), Australian landscape painter. Oil on board (per title), river with cattle and gums, blue hills, approx 2:1 landscape format, linen slip and mount in gilt/timber frame. Signature lower right reads Wykeham Perry in the photo crop, consistent with the artist's usual hand. Typical market-level Perry, a better-than-average composition with a river and cattle and a good frame.
